relations.myth: Hypsipyle guides the thirsty army to a spring
relations.note: She leaves Opheltes temporarily and guides the Seven to water at Nemea.

relations.myth: Funeral of Opheltes and founding of Nemean Games
relations.note: After a serpent kills Opheltes, the Seven conduct his funeral games.

relations.myth: Recovery and burial of the fallen Seven
relations.note: Theseus defeats the Thebans and recovers the fallen attackers’ bodies for burial.

relations.myth: Peaceful recovery of the fallen Seven
relations.note: A competing tradition says Theseus recovered their bodies through agreement rather than conquest.

relations.myth: Invocation before the assault on Thebes
relations.note: The expedition invokes martial destruction and symbolically claims Ares’ favor.
